definitions.explanation: The division within a company or organization responsible for managing finances, bookkeeping, and accounting.

examples.japanese: {経理課|けいりか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: To submit documents to the accounting department.

examples.japanese: {経理課|けいりか}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{経費|けいひ}→経費：04696_keihi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{精算|せいさん}→精算：10899_seisan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I had my expenses reimbursed by the accounting department.

examples.japanese: ⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{経理課|けいりか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{異動|いどう}→異動：01818_idou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ことになった。
examples.english: I have been transferred to the accounting department starting next month.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{経理|けいり}→経理：06439_keiri⟧ (accounting, financial management) + ⟦{課|か}→課：01548_ka⟧ (section, department). In Japanese companies, ⟦{課|か}→課：01548_ka⟧ is a standard organizational unit below ⟦{部|ぶ}→〜部：00440_bu⟧ (division). The {経理課|けいりか} handles daily bookkeeping, expense processing, payroll, and financial reporting.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {経理課|けいりか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}する→提出する：19644_teishutsusuru⟧: to submit to the accounting department
- {経理課|けいりか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{担当者|たんとうしゃ}→担当者：09676_tantousha⟧: person in charge in the accounting department
- {経理課|けいりか}{長|ちょう}: head of the accounting section

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {経理部|けいりぶ}: accounting division — a larger organizational unit than {経理課|けいりか}
- ⟦{総務課|そうむか}→総務課：24613_soumuka⟧: general affairs department — handles administrative matters rather than finances
- ⟦{人事課|じんじか}→人事課：19073_jinjika⟧: human resources department
